sources.details: If task j has n_j rows and c_j correct, micro=sum_j c_j/sum_j n_j and equal-task=mean_j(c_j/n_j). Changing n_j changes the micro weight n_j/sum n. With12 current joint tasks,78/90=0.8666666667 while equal-task=(10/12+1+5/6+1+1+0+1+1+1+1+1+1)/12=0.8888888889. CPU independently executes both; no additional course metric is claimed.
